detail.longDescription: I made Buddy, a free and open-source Mac app for Claude Code. It sits in the MacBook notch and shows what each session is doing. When a session asks for permission or finishes, Buddy hops and plays a sound (and a badge stays until you answer). It runs on Apple silicon Macs with macOS 14 or later, under the MIT license. https:// github.com/purplelink-llc/budd y?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=buddy-launch-test # MacApps # ClaudeCode # OpenSource
